question: Which sacred formula did he continually chant during his austerity?
premises: The chant was an eight-syllabled great vidyā.
inference: He continually chanted the eight-syllabled great vidyā of Mahākālī.
uncertainties: The specific eight syllables of the vidyā are not given in this verse.
plain_english: He was always chanting the eight-syllabled great vidyā of Mahākālī.
